solution: The man had a superpower: he could foresee the age at which a person would die. After boarding the train, he saw that the people on board all looked to be about the same age as he was when he would die. He found this very strange, so he tentatively asked a few people and discovered that all of them were going to die that very year. When he asked the old woman, he realized that the train would have an accident in five minutes, and everyone on board would die.
canonical_facts: The man can foresee people’s ages at death
He asks passengers their ages and finds them matching his predictions
The woman’s imminent birthday makes him infer a common disaster in five minutes
Within this fictional story he concludes the train will crash and everyone aboard will die; do not require a real-world proof from age alone
